items.t: Russian missile lands in Poland during allied drills
items.d: Tusk called it a Moscow 'provocation'. No one was hurt, but it came as Ukraine's allies held a military exercise, raising NATO tensions again.

items.t: Zelensky defends Crimean Bridge strikes in UK talks
items.d: Meeting Britain's Wes Streeting, Zelensky called the strikes a 'fair response' to 109 Russian air attacks on Ukrainian bridges, after Russia hit Kyiv crossings.

items.t: Denmark accuses Russia of plot to kill rapper
items.d: Copenhagen expelled Russia's defence attaché over an alleged plan to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper. Russia's embassy denies it.

items.t: ANC fights to hold South Africa's big cities
items.d: After a local election setback, the ANC seems reluctant to repeat its national power-sharing deal with the pro-business DA in city councils.

items.t: Mexican cartel boss on FBI most-wanted list caught
items.d: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, accused of drug trafficking and torture, was arrested after a gunfight, a major win for US-Mexico cooperation.

items.t: Nepal's new PM tests ties on first India visit
items.d: Balendra Shah's talks in Delhi focus on trade, connectivity and regional cooperation, a key test of Nepal's balance between India and China.

items.t: Cost-of-living protests sweep Europe
items.d: Thousands marched in cities across Europe on Friday over living costs and other grievances, a sign of pressure on governments.

items.t: Tech sell-off pushes S&P 500 and Dow into correction
items.d: Anthropic shares slid after its debut and tech stocks fell, dragging both indexes more than 10% below their peaks.

items.t: Bayer's $7.25bn Roundup settlement approved
items.d: A US judge approved the deal covering people with non-Hodgkin lymphoma linked to the weedkiller, including future cases, easing a huge legal risk for Bayer.

items.t: US group beats China to $60bn Kenya minerals deal
items.d: A US consortium won rights to Mrima Hill's critical minerals, part of Washington's push to cut reliance on Chinese supply chains.

items.t: Trump threatens ban on US AI data centres abroad
items.d: Trump floated stopping US firms building AI data centres overseas but gave few details, adding uncertainty for big tech's global expansion plans.

items.t: Anthropic mathematician claims AI-aided Riemann proof
items.d: He says an AI helped prove maths' most famous unsolved problem. Experts stress the claim needs long, careful verification before anyone celebrates.

items.t: FBI probes apparent hack of national crime database
items.d: The National Crime Information Center, used by police across the US to share records, may have been breached, a serious security worry.

items.t: OpenAI reportedly picks Foxconn to build its phone
items.d: The iPhone assembler would make OpenAI's first smartphone, signalling the ChatGPT maker's push into its own hardware.

items.t: Smart devices catch 111 exam cheats in South Korea
items.d: New detection measures caught students with banned gadgets during the high-stakes Suneung university entrance exam.

items.t: Study finds why microplastics may be more harmful
items.d: Researchers identified a mechanism suggesting microplastics could pose greater health risks than thought, adding urgency to studies of their effects.

items.t: Nigeria moves to stop jailing attempted suicide
items.d: A proposed reform, long urged by psychiatrists, would treat attempted suicide as a health issue rather than a crime.

items.t: Next halts baby sleeping bag after safety alarm
items.d: A mother found the neck hole was too big, letting a baby slip down inside; the retailer stopped sales.

items.t: Miliband: EU deal not tied to tuition fees
items.d: He said the reset deal does not depend on cutting fees for EU students, after Brussels suggested it might.

items.t: England thrash New Zealand by record margin
items.d: England's rugby revival gathered pace with their biggest ever win over the All Blacks in the Nations Championship.

items.t: Man charged after Bradford councillor stabbed
items.d: Arfan Ali is charged with attempted murder over Thursday's attack on councillor Ibrar Ali.

items.t: 俄羅斯導彈落入波蘭 時值盟國軍演
items.d: 波蘭總理圖斯克指事件是莫斯科「挑釁」。事件無人受傷，但發生於烏克蘭盟友舉行軍演期間，令北約局勢再度緊張。

items.t: 澤連斯基晤英方 為襲擊克里米亞大橋辯護
items.d: 澤連斯基與英國的斯特里廷會面，稱襲擊大橋是對俄方109次空襲烏克蘭橋樑的「合理回應」；俄軍早前轟炸基輔多條過河通道。

items.t: 丹麥指俄羅斯密謀暗殺饒舌歌手
items.d: 丹麥驅逐俄羅斯國防武官，指俄方策劃暗殺一名美籍烏克蘭裔饒舌歌手。俄羅斯大使館否認指控。

items.t: 非國大力保南非大城市控制權
items.d: 地方選舉失利後，非洲人國民大會似乎不願在市議會複製與親商界民主聯盟的全國分權安排。

items.t: FBI十大通緝墨西哥毒梟槍戰後落網
items.d: 被控販毒及施酷刑的梅薩·弗洛雷斯經駁火後被捕，是美墨合作打擊毒品的重大成果。

items.t: 尼泊爾新總理首訪印度 考驗兩國關係
items.d: 巴倫德拉·沙阿在新德里的會談以貿易、互聯互通及區域合作為重點，考驗尼泊爾在印度與中國之間的平衡。

items.t: 歐洲多地爆發生活成本抗議
items.d: 周五歐洲多個城市有數以千計民眾遊行，抗議生活成本高昂等問題，反映各國政府承受壓力。

items.t: 科技股拋售 標普500及道指陷調整市
items.d: Anthropic上市後股價下滑，科技股普遍下跌，拖累兩大指數較高位回落超過一成。

items.t: 拜耳72.5億美元除草劑和解獲批
items.d: 美國法官批准和解方案，賠償因使用Roundup除草劑而患非霍奇金淋巴瘤的人士，包括日後患病者，減輕拜耳的巨大法律風險。

items.t: 美國財團擊敗中國對手 奪肯尼亞600億美元礦權
items.d: 美國財團取得姆里馬山關鍵礦產開採權，是華府減少依賴中國供應鏈的部署之一。

items.t: 特朗普揚言禁美企在海外建AI數據中心
items.d: 特朗普提出或禁止美國企業在海外興建AI數據中心，但未有交代細節，令大型科技公司的全球擴張計劃添變數。

items.t: Anthropic數學家稱借助AI證明黎曼猜想
items.d: 他表示AI協助證明了數學界最著名的未解難題。專家強調，聲稱須經長時間嚴謹驗證。

items.t: FBI調查全國罪案資料庫疑遭入侵
items.d: 全美警方用以共享紀錄的國家犯罪資訊中心資料庫疑被入侵，引起嚴重保安疑慮。

items.t: 報道指OpenAI選富士康組裝手機
items.d: 這家iPhone組裝商將生產OpenAI首部智能手機，顯示ChatGPT開發商積極進軍自家硬件。

items.t: 南韓新措施揪出111名考試作弊考生
items.d: 在高風險的大學入學試修能考試中，新偵測措施發現考生攜帶違禁智能裝置。

items.t: 研究揭微塑膠或比想像中更有害
items.d: 研究人員發現一種機制，顯示微塑膠對健康的風險可能高於預期，令相關研究更顯迫切。

items.t: 尼日利亞擬取消企圖自殺入獄刑罰
items.d: 精神科醫生多年來爭取的改革建議，將企圖自殺視為健康問題而非罪行。

items.t: Next停售嬰兒睡袋 母親揭安全隱患
items.d: 一名母親發現睡袋頸口過大，嬰兒可滑入袋內，零售商已停售。

items.t: 文禮彬：英歐協議不取決於學費
items.d: 他表示英歐重啟協議並不取決於調低歐盟學生學費，此前布魯塞爾曾暗示可能掛鈎。

items.t: 英格蘭破紀錄大勝新西蘭
items.d: 英格蘭欖球隊在國家錦標賽以史上最大比數擊敗全黑隊，復興勢頭加快。

items.t: 布拉德福德市議員遇襲 男子被控謀殺未遂
items.d: 阿凡·阿里被控於周四襲擊市議員易卜拉·阿里，涉嫌謀殺未遂。
